memory.title: Memory MCP server
memory.description: One universal server for every indexed project. Paste it into an external client (Claude Desktop, Codex, Claude Code); the client lists your projects and picks what to query.
memory.copyFailed: Could not read the MCP config
memory.unavailable: The MCP config is not available in the browser: it names the host's executable and state directory

gateway.title: Connect agents
gateway.description: One gateway serves every MCP server below. An agent adds a single se-mcp entry and reaches all of them; the gateway keeps running after Se Manager closes.
gateway.configError: The MCP configuration could not be applied: {{error}}

grouped.name: Grouped (recommended)
grouped.description: Two tools per server: <server>_tool_list and <server>_tool_call. The tool name already names the server; small tool list.

entry.name: Entry
entry.description: Four fixed tools (list_mcp_servers, list_mcp_tools, call_mcp_tool, get_mcp_server_status), same as mcp-router. Smallest tool list, one extra step.

direct.name: Direct
direct.description: Every tool of every server as <server>_<tool>. No extra step, largest tool list.

gateway.bridgeMissing: se-mcp was not found at {{path}}. Development builds need `cargo build --bin se-mcp`.

manual.httpNote: The HTTP entry carries the token and breaks when the port changes; prefer se-mcp, which reads both from the settings file.
